# Add to output, with transform f, origin offset; local_coords include ext

def paint(cells, origin, color, trans='id'):
    ro,co=origin
    for r,c in cells:
        if trans=='id': rr,cc=r,c
        elif trans=='h': rr,cc=r,N-1-c
        elif trans=='v': rr,cc=N-1-r,c
        elif trans=='180': rr,cc=N-1-r,N-1-c
        elif trans=='cw': rr,cc=c,N-1-r
        elif trans=='ccw': rr,cc=N-1-c,r
        R,C=ro+rr,co+cc
        if 0<=R<14 and 0<=C<14: out[R][C]=color

def cells_from_patch(patch):
    return [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(patch) for c,val in enumerate(row) if val]

# 2 first, horizontal flip into bottom-left
paint(cells_from_patch(p2), (7,0), 2, 'h')
# 3 next: full block with lower rows containing center hole
p3=[[3]*7 for _ in range(4)]+[[3,3,3,0,3,3,3] for _ in range(3)]
c3=cells_from_patch(p3)+[(3,c) for c in (-3,-2,-1)]
paint(c3,(0,7),3,'id')
# 7 next; core plus north tail, 180 into top-left
p7=[[7]*7 for _ in range(3)]+[[0,0,7,7,7,7,7]]+[[7]*7 for _ in range(2)]+[[7,7,7,7,7,7,5]]
c7=cells_from_patch(p7)+[(r,3) for r in (-3,-2,-1)]
paint(c7,(0,0),7,'180')
# 8 last
p8=[[8]*7 for _ in range(7)]
c8=cells_from_patch(p8)+[(3,7),(7,3),(8,3)]
paint(c8,(7,7),8,'180')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))

        elif trans=='ccw': rr,cc=N-1-c,r
        R,C=ro+rr,co+cc
